policy_source: Direct user instructions in this engineering conversation, 2026-10-03
lifecycle: After the controller actually sends an audit/research request, activate this existing heartbeat for that request. Read the results in the source thread every ten minutes. Save the needed complete result and its message identity; pause the same heartbeat after the requested result has been read. Reactivate only for the next actual request.
queue_deletion: No internal queue scanning or deletion. No need for source thread to forward its results.
usage: Periodic model invocations and result processing can consume allowance; not guaranteed zero usage.
